name: TimeBench
description: TimeBench is a large-scale time series dataset with one trillion time points curated to train and evaluate time series foundation models, supporting long-term forecasting and serial-token prediction.
reputation: A large-scale, emerging benchmark for time-series foundation models that is not yet broadly established as a community standard.
notes: Dataset used to train Timer-S1 model; includes data augmentation to reduce bias and supports long-context forecasting.
